entries.latin:
Notum sit omnibus Christi fidelibus, quod Domina Heitwich de Purchrein tradidit Deo & sancto Stephano in Wihensteven predium quoddam in Uzingen, pro remedio anime sue & ma-
riti sui Ottonis Chophes nuper de medio facti, cum consensu filii maioris Ottonis, ut fratribus ibidem Deo servientibus pleniter de-
serviat. Testes, Otto filius eius, Roudigerus de Celle, Ott de Rote, Hermannus de Tanne, Chounrat de Rosenberch.
entries.english: Let it be known to all the faithful of Christ that Lady Heitwich von Purchrein gave to God and St. Stephen in Weihenstephan a certain estate in Uzingen, for the remedy of her soul and that of her husband Otto Chophes, recently departed, with the consent of her elder son Otto, so that it may fully serve the brothers serving God there. Witnesses: Otto, her son; Rudiger von Celle; Otto von Rote; Hermann von Tanne; Konrad von Rosenberg.
